prompt: Need, or want? Sort each one.
summary: You sorted eight things, and talked through the ones that could go either way.

bus_pass.why: Without it you cannot get to class. That makes it a need.

sneakers_new.text: New sneakers, the ones everyone is wearing
sneakers_new.why: Your shoes still work. New ones would be nice, but nothing stops if you wait.

phone_recharge.why: It depends on what the phone is for. Hold that thought.
phone_recharge.context: Phone recharge — and your classes are online this month.
phone_recharge.why2: Same item, different answer. When class happens on the phone, the recharge becomes a need.

biryani_friends.why: This one is genuinely both. You could skip it, but friendships need feeding too. The question is how often, not whether.

exam_fee.why: Miss this and you miss the exam. A need, and one with a deadline.

gaming_skin.why: Fun, and nothing breaks without it. That is what makes it a want.

notebook.why: Small, cheap, and you cannot do the work without it.

umbrella.text: Umbrella, and the rains have started
umbrella.why: Getting soaked on the way to class means missed days. Cheap now, expensive later.

movie_ticket.why: A want — and wants are allowed. That is what the Wants jar is for.

haircut.why: Both, depending on the month. Before an interview it is closer to a need. Every two weeks, less so.

medicine_fever.why: Health first. Waiting on this usually costs more.

birthday_gift.text: Birthday gift for a close friend
birthday_gift.why: Both. Relationships matter, and so does the size of the gift. A cheaper gift is still a gift.

cricket_bat.why: A want. If you play every weekend it is a well-loved want, but still a want.

tiffin_box.why: Depends on what you eat at midday. Hold that thought.
tiffin_box.context: A tiffin box — and canteen food costs you ₹60 every day.
tiffin_box.why2: ₹180 once, against ₹60 a day. Here the tiffin box pays for itself in three days.

earphones.why: Usually a want. But it depends what you use them for.
earphones.context: Earphones — yours broke, and your classes are online.
earphones.why2: When you cannot hear the class, they stop being a luxury.

hostel_mess.why: Food and a roof. This is the clearest kind of need.

lab_manual.why: Required for the course, so it is a need — but ask a senior before buying new.

bedsheet.why: You have to sleep somewhere. Basic, and a need.

fest_ticket.why: A want. A good one — just one that belongs in the Wants jar, not the Needs jar.

coaching_fees.why: This one is hard, and it should be. It is a want if free material would do, and closer to a need if that coaching is your route to the course you want. Either answer is defensible.

auto_fare_late.context: Auto fare home — it is 10pm and the last bus has gone.
auto_fare_late.why2: Getting home safely is a need. Safety is never the thing to save on.

phone_upgrade.why: Your phone works. This is a want wearing a need's clothes.

laptop_repair.why: Depends what the laptop is for. Hold that thought.
laptop_repair.context: Laptop repair — and your submissions are all online.
laptop_repair.why2: When your marks depend on it, the repair is a need. Get a quote first.

chai_daily.text: Chai at the corner shop, every day this month
chai_daily.why: ₹20 feels like nothing. Every day, it is ₹440 a month. Small and often is still big.

photocopy_notes.why: Cheap, and it is the material you study from. A need.

household_share.text: Your share of the household expenses
household_share.why: Your family counts on it. This is a need, and it is the first thing to plan for.

sibling_fee.why: A need, and a fixed one. It arrives the same month every year, so plan for it.

lpg_cylinder.text: A gas cylinder for the house
lpg_cylinder.why: Cooking gas is a need. It is also predictable — you know roughly when the next one is due.

festival_clothes.why: Both, and that is honest. Festivals matter. The question is the amount, not whether.

petrol_work.why: This is what earns you the rest of the money. A need.

ott_subscription.why: ₹199 a month is ₹2,388 a year. A want — worth checking you still watch it.

parent_checkup.text: A health check-up for your mother
parent_checkup.why: A need. Check-ups cost less than what they catch.
